# `dry fleet`

Query Moonraker live printer status or send dynamic tuning commands to fleet

## Help

```text
Query Moonraker live printer status or send dynamic tuning commands to fleet

Usage: dry fleet <COMMAND>

Commands:
  status  Query live Moonraker printer status (state, progress, temperatures)
  tune    Set Klipper dynamic pressure advance on a live printer
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
```
